description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to media pipeline capabilities, including a factory for creating media pipeline capabilities and the implementation class that manages supported MIME types and capabilities via GStreamer.

classes.name: MediaPipelineCapabilitiesFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating IMediaPipelineCapabilities instances.

classes.name: MediaPipelineCapabilities
classes.description: Implementation of IMediaPipelineCapabilities that provides media capabilities information.

methods.name: createMediaPipelineCapabilities
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of IMediaPipelineCapabilities.

methods.name: getSupportedMimeTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of supported MIME types for a given media source type.

methods.name: isMimeTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific MIME type is supported.
